terminal_name: Nivalan Biokaasu bio-LNG plant (Nivala) - Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners
issue: Surfaced in the trade-press sweep (LNG Prime, Sep 2025): Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CI Advanced Bioenergy Fund I) took FID on Nivalan Biokaasu, billed as Finland's largest industrial biogas plant, in Nivala (inland, Northern Ostrobothnia). It will process >600,000 t/y of biomass and produce ~200 GWh/y of liquefied biomethane (bio-LNG); construction late 2025, ops H2 2027; ~EUR 26m Finnish MEAE grant. Examined for completeness; judged OUT OF SCOPE - it is a biomethane digestion/liquefaction PRODUCTION plant, not an LNG import/export/regasification terminal handling natural gas, so it is not a GEM Gas Infrastructure Tracker LNG terminal. Logged so it is not re-examined as a candidate each sweep.
suggested_action: Do NOT stage as a GEM LNG terminal. If GEM ever decides to track bio-LNG liquefaction plants, revisit. Lead source (url_verifier PASS): https://lngprime.com/europe/copenhagen-infrastructure-partners-takes-fid-on-finnish-bio-lng-plant/163738/.
